title: solve-feature result.json
description: One solve-feature run's ending and its evidence, written to .coding-crew/solve-feature/result.json whenever the run writes its outcome file. A run killed before then leaves none.

status.description: The outcome line's leading word (a `stopped: …` line gives stopped).

head.description: HEAD when the file was written.

pr.description: The PR's number; absent with solveFeature.publish false, or before a PR exists.

pr_title.description: The PR writer's title, from its summary file's `# <title>` line; with solveFeature.publish false, the local PR body file's title. Absent until either file exists.

pr_summary.description: The PR writer's summary file without its `# <title>` line, as it wrote it: none of the banner, markers, Needs attention lines, notes section or script-written Tested line describe adds around it. Absent until that file exists.

pr_body.description: With solveFeature.publish false: the local PR body file's body; absent until that file exists.

issues.description: One entry per issue section of this run's spec.md.

commits.description: Subjects of the branch's first-parent commits carrying the issue's [<slug>] prefix, oldest first.

checks.description: The checks land ran on the issue and the commit they passed on; null when this run did not land it.

red.description: The coder's `<file>: <test name> — <failing line>` lines, one per new test seen failing.

rounds.description: One entry per review round, oldest first.

spec.description: The review's spec verdict: met, unmet or none.

fixed.description: True when this round's fixer_changed_code is true and no unfixed entry names this finding. Absent on every finding of a round whose fix stopped (fixer_changed_code null) or whose unfixed holds an entry naming no finding, and on an entry that was not an object.

test.description: `<file>: <test name>`, as the reviewer named it.

red.description: The red line for exactly that test, else null.

unfixed.description: The findings the fixer left unfixed, from its unfixed.json. A finding is fixed when this round's fixer_changed_code is true and it is not listed here. A file off this shape is one entry with no finding and the file's raw text as why.

unmatched_red.description: Red lines no criterion of this round cites.

fixer_changed_code.description: null when the round's fix stopped first.

checks_commit.description: The commit the round's checks passed on.

re_reviewed.description: Whether a later round reviewed this round's fixes.

needs_attention.description: What needs a person, one typed item per reason: the last finished fix round's items, then describe's. The run ends needs-attention exactly when this is non-empty, and the body's Needs attention lines are rendered from it; [] when the run ends ready or no review round ran. round is the 0-based index into rounds.

round.description: spec_unmet, unfixed, fixer_changed_nothing: the round it comes from.

gaps.description: spec_unmet: indices into rounds[round].gaps; empty when the spec is not met with no gap named.

finding.description: unfixed: index into rounds[round].findings; absent when the fixer's file was off its shape.

severity.description: unfixed: that finding's severity; null when it has none or the index is out of range.

why.description: unfixed: the fixer's reason, or the raw text of a file off its shape.

author.description: note: from the script-written header above it; person for text under none.

text.description: note: the note's text, as the PR body's notes section holds it.

count.description: unresolved_threads: the PR's unresolved review threads.
